limitations: This is actual machine audition of decoded source audio, not human auditory perception.
Narration dominates the full mix and can mask low-level music, effects, or embedded result audio.
The L-R residual suppresses centered content and is only supplementary; it cannot prove a centered event absent.
AudioSet labels such as keyboard, zipper, heartbeat, animal, or typewriter may describe timbre rather than literal source identity and are not accepted as literal events without corroboration.
No independently attributable result-clip sound does not mean the embedded clip is silent; availability remains unknown.

narration.basis: Speech is the leading original-mix AudioSet label in all four regions and agrees with supplied subtitles.

music.basis: Music is detected in every original region and is the leading center-cancelled residual label in every region; residual RMS changes from 0.011046 opening to 0.005030 input/queue, 0.002582 result reveal, then 0.011893 closing.
notEstablished: whether all music comes from one bed

shortEffects.basis: Residual windows intermittently rank Sound effect and occasional Whoosh/swoosh/swish, Bang, Ding or Ping labels; these low-confidence labels can also be music percussion and are not accepted as exact literal identities.
notEstablished: whether candidates are separate SFX or part of music

displayedResultClipOwnAudio.basis: At the 13.35-second result reveal and through 18.137 seconds, machine listening continues to detect narration and music but no new source can be independently tied to the displayed CG clip. The post mix and visible Lip Sync control prevent an absence conclusion.
notEstablished: whether the displayed result file contains an audio track
whether audio is audible in the UI player
